new_inspected_claims.finding: alpha and indepTest must be supplied; stable skeleton default; conservative, majority and conflict options default false. NAdelete=true can remove an edge after a missing CI result. A stable skeleton alone does not remove every orientation order dependence.
new_inspected_claims.implication: Pin CI test, error behavior and orientation options; preserve equivalence and ambiguity. A missing statistical test must not silently become evidence of independence.

new_inspected_claims.finding: Default alpha .05. Test selection depends on data type: categorical mutual information, ordered-factor Jonckheere–Terpstra, continuous linear correlation. Some local discovery routines default to undirected output. Incomplete data use locally complete CI tests.
new_inspected_claims.implication: Mixed types and different per-test sample sets need explicit diagnostics. An extension of a partially directed graph is not evidence that all selected directions are identified.

new_inspected_claims.finding: hc/tabu default to BIC scores for discrete and continuous data; absent start means empty DAG. hc has zero random restarts by default; maximum iterations and parents default infinite; tabu list default length 10.
new_inspected_claims.implication: Proposed resource caps and optimization restarts must be part of the adapter/benchmark contract; a score optimum is not causal identification.

new_inspected_claims.finding: mmhc is rsmax2 with mmpc restriction and hc maximization; h2pc uses hpc and hc.
new_inspected_claims.implication: Treat named hybrids as compositions with inherited defaults rather than unrelated independent implementations.

new_inspected_claims.finding: DirectLiNGAM interface exposes pwling/default or gkernel ordering measure and adaptive LASSO maximization; shrinkage selection defaults to BIC penalty.
new_inspected_claims.implication: Do not transfer Gaussian equivalence-class guarantees to a functional-model method merely because both return a graph. Scope and assumptions still require full method review.
